project.name: Class-library additions for running course programs in the browser
project.description: java.util.Scanner (missing in TeaVM), java.util.InputMismatchException, and a Formatter with JDK-compatible %n and %f rounding. web-bridge lists this artifact before teavm-classlib, so TeaVM finds these classes first; the in-browser compiler (teavm-javac) gets them added to its class libraries at build time (.github/workflows, browser-javac).
